entities.summary: Rrok Gjonlleshaj is a Montenegrin Albanian prelate of the Catholic Church who serves as the Archbishop of Bar from 2016. He served as the apostolic administrator of Kotor from 2023 to 2024, a post he also held from 2019 to 2021.
